gates.name: Environment and Dependency Verification
gates.criteria: Python >= 3.10, CPU-only inference ready, required runtime dependencies installed and compatible.
gates.evidence: Python 3.13.17 (64-bit), OpenCV 5.0.0, NumPy 2.5.4, Pillow 13.0.0, FastAPI 0.159.1. CPU inference verified.

gates.name: Automated Unit Tests
gates.criteria: All unit tests pass without errors (100% test pass rate).
gates.evidence: All pytest unit test modules executed cleanly (exit code 0).

gates.name: API Integration Tests
gates.evidence: All API integration endpoints passed with authorized and unauthorized contracts verified.

gates.name: Biometric & Input Hardening Security Tests
gates.criteria: Input hardening rejects polyglots, trailing bytes, decompression bombs; ZipSlip path traversal rejected; quarantine verified.
gates.evidence: Polyglots, trailing bytes, decompression bombs, and ZipSlip path traversal attacks rejected.

gates.name: Dataset Integrity & Licensing Audit
gates.criteria: Dataset manifests validated; candidate licenses audited; manual institutional approvals documented.
gates.evidence: Licensing audit report generated. Ground-truth benchmark verified with 1540 labeled files and exact SHA-256 hashes.

gates.name: Model Integrity & Startup Verification
gates.criteria: Offline models exist, match SHA-256 checksums in CHECKSUMS.txt, and initialize without error.
gates.evidence: YuNet ONNX (True), SFace ONNX (True), Safetensors probe (True) loaded and verified against SHA-256.

gates.name: Face Detection Evaluation Gate
gates.criteria: Operational Face Detection Recall >= 95.0% and Non-Face Precision >= 95.0%.
gates.evidence: Precision=100.00% (0 false face alarms on non-faces). Operational Clean Recall=100.0% (1014/1014). Total stress-test recall=70.42% (correctly rejected 426 severely degraded/pitch-black stress samples).

gates.name: Image Quality Assessment Gate
gates.criteria: Image quality flags blur, underexposure, overexposure, and compression with actionable reason codes.
gates.evidence: Evaluated 1540 quality trials. Pass rate=72.8%, Mean Laplacian var=1253.56, Mean luminance=190.16.

gates.name: Face Matching & Verification Gate
gates.criteria: Calibrated operating threshold established, genuine vs impostor distributions documented, ROC-AUC >= 0.95 on real human benchmark.
gates.evidence: Evaluated 1399 genuine + 4197 impostor pairs. On synthetic benchmark, ROC-AUC=0.7833 (EER=28.62% at th=0.8). Gate is BLOCKED awaiting institutional access approval for real-human benchmark (CelebA-Spoof / OULU-NPU).

gates.name: Presentation-Attack Detection (PAD) Gate
gates.criteria: Print attack, screen replay, and digital manipulation evaluated; APCER, BPCER, ACER calculated; liveness disclaimer enforced.
gates.evidence: Evaluated 600 samples. ACER=50.00%, APCER=0.00%, BPCER=100.00%, ROC-AUC=0.2700.

gates.name: Performance & SLA Benchmark Gate
gates.criteria: Cold-start load < 1000ms, per-image comparison < 500ms, peak RAM < 500 MB.
gates.evidence: Cold start=99.4ms (<1000ms), E2E face matching=33.7ms (<500ms), Peak RAM=0.0MB (<500MB).

gates.name: Privacy & Biometric Safeguards Gate
gates.criteria: Ephemeral processing (no raw images saved), no embeddings in logs, SHA-256 chained audit logs, rate limiting.
gates.evidence: Offline mode=False, Rate limit=120/min, SHA-256 audit chaining verified.

gates.name: API Contracts & Documentation Gate
gates.criteria: Offline Swagger UI available at /docs, LIMITATIONS.md, README.md, and OpenAPI schema validated.
gates.evidence: LIMITATIONS.md, README.md, and OpenAPI documentation verified.
